request.description:
Expected email behavior:
1. Internal email should be sent to: QUERY_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL
2. Customer email should be sent to: {{customerEmail}}
3. Internal subject should contain: New Tattoo Inquiry
4. Internal subject should contain: inquiryNumber
5. Customer subject should contain: We Received Your Tattoo Inquiry
6. Customer subject should contain: inquiryNumber

After running this request, verify the configured mailbox manually if SMTP inbox verification is not available.
